Definition: from G1893 and G4007; since indeed (of cause):--seeing.
BiblicalUsage: Epeiper means seeing that, since indeed — Paul's word in Romans for the oneness of God: seeing it is one God, who shall justify the circumcision by faith and the uncircumcision through faith. One God, one way of being made right.
TheologicalSignificance: One God means one door, and faith is how both Jew and Gentile walk through it, and I hold that this single verse holds the whole gospel together.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
